title: Tusk's Vault
description:
This is a bridge, not the archivist. It does nothing on its own. It needs Tusk's Vault — a separate, free, self-hosted app — installed and running on the GM's own computer. Install that first.

With Vault running, ask your campaign's own lore from the Foundry chat bar. Type /tusk who is the harbour master? and the answer comes back cited to the session logs, NPC pages and setting documents you already keep, rather than to a model's guess about a generic fantasy world.

Your notes never leave the GM's machine except as part of a question to whichever model provider you configured. Players install nothing.

Setup, tutorials and troubleshooting: kochitusker.github.io/Tusks-Vault · source on GitHub
